map.根据房间面积与地板规格，计算所需地板片数、采购箱数及踢脚线用量。: Computes required plank count, purchase boxes and skirting by room area and flooring spec.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.ceil(net×(1+p.waste÷1: Core formula (by inputs): Math.ceil(net x (1+p.waste/100)); p.fLen x p.fWid/1000000; Math.ceil(total/p.perBox)
map.💡 单块面积 = 长 × 宽 ÷ 1000000（m²）；片数 = 面积 ÷ 单: Plank area = length x width / 1000000 (m2); count = area / plank area x (1 + waste), round up; skirting by room perimeter.
map.地板与墙面间需预留 8-12mm 伸缩缝: Leave 8-12mm expansion gap between floor and wall.
map.踢脚线按周长估算并含 5% 损耗，门洞处可扣除: Skirting estimated by perimeter + 5% waste; deduct door openings.
map.铺强化/实木复合地板，按实测面积加 5%–8% 损耗得采购量，长条房型损耗低于人: For laminate/engineered flooring, measured area + 5%-8% waste gives purchase; elongated rooms waste less than herringbone.
map.核算踢脚线总长（房间周长减门洞）与防潮垫面积，避免辅料漏买。: Tally skirting length (perimeter minus doors) and underlay area to avoid missing accessories.
map.对比整片购买与按㎡计价的差异，结合损耗选更省的方案。: Compare full-box vs per-m2 pricing and pick the cheaper with waste.
map.房间 18㎡，地板 1215×195mm≈0.237㎡/片，损耗 5%\n采购面:
Room 18 m2, plank 1215x195mm~0.237 m2/pc, waste 5%
Purchase area = 18 x 1.05 = 18.9 m2
Count = 18.9 / 0.237 ~ 80 pcs
map.常规铺法 5%，人字/鱼骨拼 8%–12%，异形或窄条房更高；本工具按你输入损耗: Standard 5%, herringbone/fishbone 8%-12%, irregular or narrow rooms more; this tool uses your input waste.
map.实木地板常打龙骨，龙骨用量另算（间距×长度）；本工具只算面层地板与常规辅料。: Solid wood often uses joists; joist quantity is separate (spacing x length). This tool counts only surface flooring and common accessories.
map.整包未拆通常可退，拆包按商家规则；建议留 1–2 片备用补损，其余按退换政策处理: Unopened full boxes are usually returnable per shop rules; keep 1-2 spares for damage, handle the rest per return policy.
map.结合地板规格与损耗率，计算所需地板片数、采购箱数，并按房间形状估算踢脚线用量，一: Combines flooring spec and waste to compute plank count and boxes, and estimates skirting by room shape, completing the purchase budget in one step.
